description: P(recovery | X, action). CRITICAL: OBSERVATIONAL_DATA, not a randomized experiment -- selected_action is assigned by a policy-like rule correlated with amount/failure_reason/prior_recovery_rate (see generator source), so action and case difficulty are confounded by construction. Any 'action X recovers more' comparison read off this data directly is biased and must not be treated as a causal claim.
intended_use: OBSERVATIONAL_DATA -- for offline-policy-evaluation-style inspection only, not causal effect estimation (see application/offline_policy_evaluation.py's own rule).
